notes: Gold = framework sources only (src/), tests excluded. Facade @method docblocks are not callers. Several tasks target recent components (Image, Concurrency, Http client batches, cache failover, Cache::flexible) rather than famous internals. `search` is the phrase an agent would derive from the question (English, no identifier the developer did not give). Re-check with `kopt bench laravel --verify`.

tasks.question: Where does the cache return a stale value while refreshing it in the background after the response is sent, with a lock so that only one refresh runs (stale-while-revalidate)?
tasks.search: cache stale value refresh background after response lock
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v13.35.0: Repository::flexible reads the value and its illuminate:cache:flexible:created: timestamp, returns the value while fresh, otherwise schedules a refresh closure (guarded by store->lock(...)->get and a created-timestamp check) through Illuminate\Support\defer (imported with `use function`), which queues a DeferredCallback run after the response.

tasks.question: When an `Illuminate\Image\Image` is turned into bytes, where are the queued transformations (cover, blur, rotate...) actually applied, and how can a custom transformation handler be registered for a driver?
tasks.search: Image toBytes transformations applied driver custom transformation handler
tasks.verifiedBy: Read src/Illuminate/Image@v13.35.0: Image::toBytes calls resolveDriver()->process(contents, pipeline) once; InterventionDriver::process decodes, then for each transformation uses transformationHandlerFor (handlers registered via ImageManager::transformUsing(driver, class, callback)) or a built-in match (Cover, Contain, Crop...), then encodes.

tasks.question: Where does password validation check whether a password appeared in a known data breach (Have I Been Pwned range API with a hashed prefix)?
tasks.search: password validation data breach pwned range api hash prefix
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v13.35.0: Password::passes (uncompromised option) resolves UncompromisedVerifier (bound to NotPwnedVerifier) and calls verify(); NotPwnedVerifier::verify upper-cases sha1, sends the 5-char prefix through search() to https://api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/ and compares suffix counts with the threshold.

tasks.question: Where does `FailoverStore` try the next cache store when one throws, and when is the `CacheFailedOver` event dispatched?
tasks.search: FailoverStore next cache store failed CacheFailedOver event
tasks.verifiedBy: Read FailoverStore.php@v13.35.0: every operation goes through attemptOnAllStores, which calls the method on each configured store in order, records failing stores, dispatches CacheFailedOver only for a store that was not already failing, and rethrows the last exception when all fail.

tasks.question: How does `Http::batch()` send several requests concurrently, cap the concurrency, and call the progress, catch, then and finally callbacks?
tasks.search: http client batch concurrent requests concurrency progress catch then finally
tasks.verifiedBy: Read Batch.php@v13.35.0: send() wraps request promises in a Guzzle EachPromise (with 'concurrency' when concurrency() was set); fulfilled/rejected handlers call the progress or catch callbacks and incrementFailedRequests; results are re-sorted in request order, then() runs only if !hasFailures(), finally() always.

tasks.question: How does `Concurrency::run()` with the process driver execute closures in parallel child processes and get their return values (or exceptions) back?
tasks.search: concurrency run closures parallel child processes results
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v13.35.0: ProcessDriver::run starts a process pool of `artisan invoke-serialized-closure` commands with LARAVEL_INVOKABLE_CLOSURE (base64 serialized SerializableClosure) and the dehydrated Context in env, then json_decodes each output; InvokeSerializedClosureCommand::handle runs the closure and writes {successful, result | exception, message, parameters}; run() rethrows failures.

tasks.question: How does the `ThrottlesExceptions` job middleware decide whether to release, delete or fail a job after an exception, and how long the job waits before the next attempt?
tasks.search: ThrottlesExceptions job middleware release delete fail retry delay
tasks.verifiedBy: Read ThrottlesExceptions.php@v13.35.0: handle() releases immediately when the RateLimiter has too many attempts (getTimeUntilNextRetry), clears the key on success, and on exception honours when/report callbacks, deletes (shouldDelete) or fails (shouldFail) the job, else hits the limiter and releases after getTimeUntilNextRetryAfterException (backoff).
